name: inventory-db
description: NocoDB-style spreadsheet database for inventory management

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
